_comment: Single source for the assistant's name and fixed texts (EN/RU – the site's languages). Used by the site widget (build.py) and the chat Worker. Change the name here, rebuild the site and redeploy the Worker. The AI itself can still answer in other languages.

greeting.en: Hi! I'm Cha, your virtual tea concierge at Moychay Phuket. I can help you explore our teas, discover tea ceremonies and plan your visit. How can I help?
greeting.ru: Привет! Я Ча, виртуальный чайный консультант Moychay Phuket. Помогу выбрать чай, узнать о церемониях и спланировать визит. Чем могу помочь?

en.ceremonies: Tell me about your tea ceremonies.
en.visit: Where are you and when are you open?
en.shop: How can I order tea online?

ru.visit: Где вы находитесь и когда открыты?
